summary: Frontend-only verification of CRM Territories Map staff pin CLICK CARD and EXPORT-with-pins features. Logged in as owner@isodemo.com, switched to Corporate, opened Territories -> Map, enabled Staff pins, clicked Jordan Blake's pin. Card renders with correct name/role/postcode/email and a working 'View profile' button. Card dismisses via close button, outside click, AND Escape. Export SVG triggers a download (uk-territory-coverage-2026-08-10.svg) with pins visible on-screen so they're serialized into the SVG.

test_results.card_view_profile_button: PASS (button, opens /platform/staffing in new tab via window.open — verified new page context)

critical_code_review_comments: 'View profile' is a <button> using window.open('/platform/staffing') — this always opens the generic staffing page, not the specific staff member's profile. If a per-user deep link is desired later (e.g. /platform/staffing?staff_id=...), it's a small enhancement, not a blocker for this spec.
